name: monthly BYSETPOS=-1: the last weekday of each month
note: BYSETPOS=-1 takes the last entry of the month's BYDAY candidate set. January 2026 ends on Saturday Jan 31, so the last weekday is Friday Jan 30. February 2026 (not a leap year) ends on Saturday Feb 28, so the last weekday is Friday Feb 27. March 2026 ends on Tuesday Mar 31. Jan 30 and Feb 27 are EST (UTC-5) at 15:00Z; Mar 31 is EDT (UTC-4) after the 2026-03-08 transition, so 10:00 local is 14:00Z.
